messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - elevated error rate for HelioCore (vpc-dedicated pool 'hc-prod-pool') detected by ingress-healthcheck. Error spike at 1735501228. Initiating incident thread.
Neal - OnCall: I'm on it, pulling metrics and tracing now. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.
Maria G: seeing 502s from the canary slice (hc-canary-01). RTTs spiking, CPU on that slice is normal but connection resets uptick. APM span shows repeated downstream timeout to model-server:predict.
Aditya P: linking logs — https://apm.example/trace/heliocore/17355 (redacted). majority of failures are from requests touching model v2.1.3-quant.
Jonah L: can we divert HelioCore traffic off the canary slice while we triage? runbook suggests pin to previous artifact if canary is bad.
Neal - OnCall: agree. Plan: 1) isolate tenant traffic from canary 2) pin artifact to v2.1.2 for HelioCore route 3) run quick smoke and release. Starting isolation now.
Neal - OnCall: running traffic divert command to route policy:
```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant helio-core --pool hc-prod-pool --route canary --action divert --to stable-slice
```
Neal - OnCall: diversion applied, canary traffic count dropped from ~15% to 0.5%. Monitoring for errors.
SRE-Runner-Bot: automated check: canary pod restart count increased by 4 in last 10m on hc-canary-01.
Maria G: good catch. I'm also seeing the pinned artifact hash difference between v2.1.3-quant and v2.1.2 is the quant kernels; could be an execution path regression on this GPU type.
Aditya P: I'm preparing the pin command to set HelioCore route to v2.1.2 pinned. Will attach rollout freeze.
Aditya P: executing pinned artifact command:
```
redwoodctl artifacts pin --tenant helio-core --model-id m-helio-chat --version v2.1.2 --reason "emergency rollback - canary failures" --freeze true
```
Aditya P: pin succeeded. Registry shows helio-core model routes now target v2.1.2.
Jonah L: triggering safe canary kill to ensure no new instances of 2.1.3 come up:
```
kubectl rollout pause deploy/hc-canary --namespace helio-core
kubectl delete pod -l app=hc-canary -n helio-core --grace-period=0 --force
```
Jonah L: pods terminated, new pods are coming up with v2.1.2 image.
Neal - OnCall: running smoke tests against helio-core api routes:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/heliocore/v1/chat -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' | jq .status
```
Neal - OnCall: smoke ok on 6/6 requests, latency back to baseline (~120ms p50). Errors dropping.
Olivia (CS): pinging HelioCore support@heliocore.com: "We've detected degraded behavior with your canary; we've diverted and pinned to previous model. We'll update in 30m with remediation notes."
Maria G: metric graphs: 502 rate down from 8% to 0.6% after pin. link: https://metrics.example/heliocore/canary/errors (internal)
Neal - OnCall: enabling temporary enhanced logs for HelioCore tenant for 1h. command:
```
redwoodctl logging set --tenant helio-core --level debug --duration 60m
```
Neal - OnCall: enabled.
Aditya P: scheduling postmortem owner and followup actions: assign to @Aditya (root cause investigation on quant kernels) and @Maria (smoke/eval re-run for v2.1.3 on hc-prod hardware).
Jonah L: will open an internal incident ticket with runbook link and timeline. ticket: INC-2026-34567 (created).
Olivia (CS): HelioCore responded: "Thanks for the quick rollback. Please let us know if we should schedule a maintenance window to test v2.1.3 again." I told them we'll coordinate after RCA.
SRE-Runner-Bot: scheduled health-check monitor at 30s for next 60m.
Neal - OnCall: current status: mitigated (traffic diverted + artifact pinned). Impact: HelioCore API errors for ~18 minutes, small % of requests affected (canary traffic). Next: continue monitoring for 1h, collect logs, and start RCA. If errors reappear escalate to Eng Runtime.
Maria G: adding note — don't re-promote v2.1.3 until quant repro confirmed; add gating test to CI that runs on the hc-prod GPU profile.
Aditya P: agreed. I'll add a temporary guard in the deployment pipeline to block v2.1.3 rollout for HelioCore until tests pass.
Neal - OnCall: handing off to @Aditya for RCA tracking and to @Maria for immediate verification. I'm stepping out but will stay reachable. :white_check_mark:
